summary: Seal one tagged SenderId from the current actor incarnation or execution, with deterministic suspension, child-spawn, restart and queued-message lifetime laws; product checker/MIR/runtime NOT_RUN.
requires: an active actor-turn authority selects Actor(ActorInstanceId)
otherwise one current ExecutionId selects Execution(ExecutionId)
suspend/resume preserves identity while actor restart and structured child spawn replace the underlying origin
queued transport preserves the immutable tagged identity without extending authority
send-time allocation, runtime search, source construction, address/thread inference, serialization identity and untagged collision are forbidden
preconditions: the lexical/runtime context contract exposes current actor-turn authority and ExecutionId
normalization: one tagged SenderIdV1 origin and one ActorSenderIdentityPlanV1
decision_procedure: if actor-turn authority is active require ActorInstanceId and select Actor
otherwise require current ExecutionId and select Execution
preserve the selected identity across suspension and in queued residue
require new ActorInstanceId after restart and new ExecutionId for a structured child
reject missing, per-send, static-ActorId, ActorTurnId, untagged or runtime-searched identities
termination_metric: one finite context descriptor and one two-variant selection
evaluation_order: seal call target -> seal sender identity plan -> evaluate operands -> actor transport admission
